faq.title: Questions, answered

faq.q1: Is Jnana Diksuchika only for courses?
faq.a1: No. Jnana Diksuchika combines learning tracks, a knowledge marketplace, live workshops, and professional services — recruitment through corporate training.
faq.a2: Yes. Toggle EN / తె in the header. Key surfaces and many knowledge resources are bilingual.
faq.q3: How do payments work for Knowledge Base plans?
faq.a3: Plan UI is live; payment checkout will connect to Razorpay (or similar). See FUTURE comments in the codebase — no fake success states.
faq.a4: Under Learning → Tools. It remains a first-class engineering lab.
